Start one attempt and the one-shot unattended Trap: setup/exposure, commitment, finite shared stock manifests and allocations, fixed minute-55 check, capture retention, retrieval, custody, allowance and abandonment.

FL-01–03: roster/work assignments, incompatible activity, shared elapsed clock and actual travel; FL-18: ordinary structural repair toolkit/material/labor/tool-task and recoverable-body requirements used by the existing repair handler.
Body-use, equipment custody and physical access context for the TEST_ONLY worker; does not supply the ordinary repair price, labor or tool-task procedure.

implementations.name: Schema38 TEST_ONLY physical Trap, retrieval and finite stock membership
implemented: Preserve schema35 no-bait, schema36 bait/timing and schema37 physical Trap/retrieval wire projections; schema38 appends stock manifests and allocations.
Persist each finite manifest's shared stock identity, version, half-open effective interval and sorted actual physical member IDs.
Persist each opportunity's explicit physical-member allocation; require the whole-pool flag to match the complete manifest and require the candidate to belong to its allocation and version.
Require overlapping versions of a shared pool to agree on physical membership; check that a committed response used the applicable version at setup completion.
Exercise overlapping opportunity/version labels over one physical fish so its active response lock prevents duplicate allocation, and exercise disjoint singleton allocations across two actual fish.
Retain the schema37 setup, bait/opportunity reservation and commitment, scheduled check, same-body capture, physical retrieval, worker/custody updates and save/replay behaviors.
notImplemented: World-authoritative stock and route facts beyond TEST_ONLY records; arbitrary cross-site access/connectivity audits and full candidate-set allocation evaluation.
Multi-candidate weighted selection, recorded attraction paths, documented renewal, hazards, prey movement and anatomy admission.

Complete assembly subcomponent histories, Rod, Net, attended fishing, assistants, equipment bonuses, magical bait receipts/suppression, escaped-prey handling, deployment allowance and lawful holder handover.
Production rule authority, Unity-host integration, presentation and the complete exploration-to-management game loop.

implementations.name: TEST_ONLY off-calendar expedition companion walking
implemented: One authored off-calendar Companion can walk at its current walking Speed divided by six feet per second against the shared RuleClock, retaining exact ActorState position and partial WorldTraversalRecord state through snapshot save and restore.
Movement is rejected when the companion has incompatible active work; active movement blocks that same companion from starting incompatible camp work.
Off-calendar running is rejected until its paid Dash budget can be represented without granting free movement; the companion never enters tactical initiative or receives a tactical interval.
notImplemented: General expedition roster or assignment calendar, autonomous route choice, multiple simultaneous off-calendar movers, general encounter entry while traversing, or Unity host integration.
Off-calendar run activity and its six-second Action/Dash accounting.

implementations.name: TEST_ONLY site-aware tool repair traversal
implemented: The repair policy uses the authored fixture site position instead of a hard-coded (3,3) station coordinate; non-default site positions enter the TEST_ONLY content fingerprint while the legacy default fingerprint is preserved.
Repair admission checks the worker actual position against the supplied site position and retains the existing source-specific repair gates.
A worker walks to a non-default repair site through the existing shared-clock traversal, saves mid-edge, restores exact partial movement, arrives and explicitly starts the same repair procedure.
notImplemented: Persisted expedition assignment intent/readiness, a general work-site directory, assistant assignments, autonomous route selection, simultaneous off-calendar movement or production site authority.
Generalized spatial world records for structures, stations and tools; the repair work position remains an authored TEST_ONLY fixture fact.

implementations.name: Schema39 TEST_ONLY persisted site-aware expedition work assignments
implemented: Schema39 appends a persisted assignment record and deterministic codec after schema38; schemas1–38 retain their earlier wire layout.
Assignment requests identify a worker, procedure, target and (for retrieval) receiver; the work site is derived from the authored repair fixture or physical Trap position.

The assignment itself adds no labor interval, reservation, material, action, proficiency or time cost. The worker follows explicit existing cardinal traversal on the shared clock; readiness is persisted only at the authored site with no active edge.
An explicit start command delegates to the existing tool-repair or physical Trap-retrieval handler and stores the resulting procedure job ID. Existing admission checks remain in those handlers.
Pre-work cancellation closes the assignment without moving resources. Only one open assignment per worker is admitted in this bounded fixture.
Require an inventory-owner grant for the Trap whose custody retrieval will transfer, and count the total bounded assignment history including closed records.
notImplemented: General production work-site directory, assistant assignments, autonomous or overland routing, simultaneous off-calendar movement, encounter transitions, network ownership, and production site authority.
Assignments do not automatically resume or cancel a linked procedure after it has started; the existing procedure record and controls remain authoritative.
